Place licensed font files here to guarantee typography across devices.

Expected filenames:

- `ITCGaramondStd-LightCondensed.woff2`
- `ITCGaramondStd-LightCondensed.woff`
- `Switzer-Regular.woff2`
- `Switzer-Regular.woff`
- `Switzer-Medium.woff2`
- `Switzer-Medium.woff`

The site CSS is already configured to load these files from `/fonts/...`.
If the files are missing, the app falls back to locally installed fonts and then to system fonts.
